description: Canonical project name + historical aliases. The work-impact aggregator and the record-agent-change intake both call scripts/resolve-project-alias.ps1 to normalize any alias to its canonical name before bucketing. Append a new entry every time a project is renamed and run update-work-impact.ps1 -FullRebuild once so the dashboard rebuckets historical events.
forksDescription: External-fork repos that show up in agent-input but aren't owned projects. stats-app/scripts/generate-data.mjs drops these from byProject, projects, and totalProjects so they don't pad the count.
